transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um, hi. Yeah, I guess the main thing is I’m having a hard time staying on track. Like, I’ll be trying to do something important, like work on an application, and then some little sound outside, or my phone, or even just a random thought, kind of pulls me away before I realize it.  

It’s not like I’m trying to avoid stuff, I don’t think… I just get sidetracked really easily, and then I’m somewhere else mentally or doing something else. I’m not sure if that makes sense, but that’s been happening a lot.
Did you have this same kind of trouble staying focused when you were a child?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t want to make it sound like I was a terrible kid or anything, but even in elementary school I remember teachers moving my seat around because I’d talk when I wasn’t supposed to. And I’d forget homework sometimes, or rush through worksheets and make dumb mistakes I probably knew better than to make.

So… yeah, I guess it was kind of the same thing back then too.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about many different things?

Um… I don’t think so? I mean, I worry about stuff sometimes, like anyone, but I wouldn’t say it’s a lot of different things all the time. At least I haven’t really noticed that as the main issue. Does that answer it okay?
Do you get unwanted thoughts that keep coming into your mind even when you try to ignore them?

Um… not really, I don’t think. Like, I’ll get random thoughts popping in, but I wouldn’t say they’re unwanted in that intense way or that I’m fighting them over and over. I’m not sure if that’s what you mean, but I haven’t really noticed that being a big thing for me.
